# DIY Project Plan Skill for Muse

Plans a DIY or renovation project end to end: a conversational 9-step workflow that asks one question at a time (the project, your skill level, budget, location), then produces a materials list with quantities, required tools, time estimates, seasonal and weather constraints (via its `data/seasonal-rules.json`), and safety recommendations. It's built for the reality of home ownership — the questions arrive in the order a contractor would ask them. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the repo is very young (0 stars, 4 installs at listing time) and the seasonal-rules file is worth verifying for your region — the content looks US-centric. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
